543	/-- `rewind_keeps_older_marks` (DS-v2, non-normative: "otherwise returns those cells to available
544	and removes m and every mark above it"; §46 metadata, §62 `ok` effect): after an `ok` of
545	`rewind m`, the marks of the stack are exactly those older than `m`, its top is the top of `m`
546	(the cells above `m` are available again), the other stacks are unchanged, and no initialization
547	changes. -/
548	theorem rewind_keeps_older_marks {k : K} {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark}
549	    (h : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D')) {st : Stack} (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st)
550	    {pre post : List Mark} (hs : st.marks = pre ++ m :: post) (hpre : m ∉ pre) :
551	    (∃ st', D'.stacks[j]? = some st' ∧ st'.marks = pre ∧ st'.top = m.top) ∧
552	      (∀ i, i ≠ j → D'.stacks[i]? = D.stacks[i]?) ∧ D'.kern.I = D.kern.I := by
553	  cases h with
554	  | ok hst₀ _ _ hsp hrl =>
555	    rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀
556	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
557	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
558	    refine ⟨⟨_, List.getElem?_set_self (lt_of_getElem? hst), ?_, rfl⟩,
559	      fun i hi => List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm hi), ?_⟩
560	    · simp only [rewindMeta]; rw [hs]; exact takeWhile_ne_append post hpre
561	    · rw [releaseEff_I]; rfl

570	/-- Every kernel step keeps `DBound` (support for DS-v2, non-normative; §60–§75 `ok` effects on
571	`D`, §42): each effect keeps, drops or moves existing anchors, adds an active authority (§64,
572	§65), or replaces an anchor by an element of its origin chain (§73); `A` never shrinks. -/
573	theorem kstep_dBound {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') (hb : DBound s) : DBound s' := by
574	  have hA := kstep_akeep h
575	  suffices H : ∀ q, ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, x < s.A.length from fun q x hx => hA.lt (H q x hx)
576	  cases h with
577	  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
578	  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
579	  | release hs =>
580	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
581	    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
582	    rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; intro q z hz
583	    simp only at hz; split at hz
584	    · exact hb q z (List.mem_filter.1 hz).1
585	    · exact hb q z hz
586	  | transfer hs =>
587	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
588	    intro q z hz; simp only [transferEff] at hz; split at hz
589	    · cases hz
590	    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hz with hz | hz
591	      · exact hb q z hz
592	      · simp only [movedTo, List.mem_flatMap] at hz
593	        obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := hz; exact hb r z hr
594	  | depend hs =>
595	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
596	    intro q z hz; simp only [dependEff] at hz; split at hz
597	    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hz with hz | hz
598	      · exact hb _ z hz
599	      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hz]; obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hp.anchorActive; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
600	    · exact hb q z hz
601	  | enter hs =>
602	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
603	    intro q z hz; simp only [enterEff] at hz; split at hz
604	    · cases hz
605	    · exact hb q z hz
606	  | exit hs =>
607	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
608	    intro q z hz; simp only [exitEff, List.mem_map] at hz
609	    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
610	    have hxl := hb q x hx
611	    cases hf : firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) with
612	    | none => exact hxl
613	    | some w =>
614	      rcases List.mem_cons.1 (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf) with rfl | hw
615	      · exact hxl
616	      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hw) hxl
617	  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
618	  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
619	  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
620	  | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
621	  | unpin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
622	  | endUse hs =>
623	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
624	    intro q z hz; simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS] at hz; split at hz
625	    · cases hz
626	    · exact hb q z hz
627	  | free hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
628	  | alloc hs =>
629	    cases hs with
630	    | ok =>
631	      intro q z hz; simp only [allocEff] at hz; split at hz
632	      · cases hz
633	      · exact hb q z hz
634	  | @store a p hs =>
635	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
636	    have hd := hp.derivedHeld
637	    cases hy : s.A[a]? with
638	    | none => rw [hy] at hd; exact hd.elim
639	    | some y =>
640	      rw [storeEff_eq hy]; intro q z hz; simp only at hz; split at hz
641	      · rcases List.mem_append.1 hz with hz | hz
642	        · exact hb _ z hz
643	        · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hz]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
644	      · exact hb q z hz

662	/-- The kernel part of a library step keeps every authority (DS-v2, non-normative; §42, `AKeep`;
663	Part XIV: the steps of `push`, `rewind`, `grow` are kernel steps). -/
664	theorem DStep.akeep {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') : AKeep D.kern D'.kern := by
665	  cases h with
666	  | kernel hk => exact kstep_akeep hk
667	  | newStack hs =>
668	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact akeep_append (List.append_nil _).symm
669	  | push hs =>
670	    cases hs with
671	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact (kstep_akeep (.split hsp)).trans (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.store hst))
672	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ _ => exact akeep_append (List.append_nil _).symm
673	  | rewind hs =>
674	    cases hs with
675	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl =>
676	      exact (kstep_akeep (.split hsp)).trans (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.release hrl))
677	  | grow hs =>
678	    cases hs with
679	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
680	      exact ((kstep_akeep (k := k) (.release hrl)).trans (kstep_akeep (.split hsp))).trans
681	        (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.store hst))

685	theorem stackShape_keep {D D' : DState} (hA : AKeep D.kern D'.kern) (hw : StackShape D)
686	    (hs : ∀ (i : Nat) (st' : Stack), D'.stacks[i]? = some st' →
687	      ∃ st : Stack, D.stacks[i]? = some st ∧ st'.internal = st.internal ∧ st'.cells = st.cells) :
688	    StackShape D' := by
689	  intro i st' h
690	  obtain ⟨st, hst, hi, hc⟩ := hs i st' h
691	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hm, hf⟩ := hw i st hst
692	  obtain ⟨y', hy', hm', hf', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
693	  exact ⟨y', hi ▸ hy', hm'.trans hm, fun c hc' => hf' ▸ hf c (hc ▸ hc')⟩

697	theorem set_keeps {l : List Stack} {j : Nat} {st st₀ : Stack} (hst : l[j]? = some st₀)
698	    (hi : st.internal = st₀.internal) (hc : st.cells = st₀.cells) :
699	    ∀ (i : Nat) (st' : Stack), (l.set j st)[i]? = some st' →
700	      ∃ st'' : Stack, l[i]? = some st'' ∧ st'.internal = st''.internal ∧
701	        st'.cells = st''.cells := by
702	  intro i st' h
703	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
704	  · exact ⟨st₀, hst, hi, hc⟩
705	  · exact ⟨st', h, rfl, rfl⟩

714	  | @newStack _ _ _ int hs =>

716	    intro i st' h

718	    · exact hw i st' h

721	      | none => rw [hy] at hi; exact hi.elim
722	      | some y =>

725	        have := hp.base.fpSup c hc; simpa [S3.afp, hy] using this

content.content:
/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v1, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): it names stack `j` and belongs to its list of live
marks. -/
def LiveMark (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop := m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks

/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v1). -/
instance (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark j st m) := by
  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance

/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v1, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
value, the place holding `internal`. -/
def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry

/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v1). -/
instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance

/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/

----

/-! ## `mark` (DS-v1) -/

/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v1, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }

/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 outcomes; §36: metadata only, no right created): `ok`
on an existing stack; the identifier is fresh. -/
inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)

/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/

/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
  { st with
    top := m.top
    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }

/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark;
`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
above `m` (reading recorded): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active
authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release`
of the derived authority (O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are
removed. -/
inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark j st m → RewindStep k j m D .fail
  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st →
      RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)

/-- `rewind` has one outcome (§58: a guarded transition has one outcome; DS-v1, non-normative):
the cases of `RewindStep` exclude each other, and `split` and `release` are deterministic
(`Guarded.det`). With `rewind_ok_iff`, an `ok` rewind is never also `reject` or `fail`. -/
theorem RewindStep.det {k : K} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} {D : DState} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 DState}

/-! ## `grow` (DS-v1: in place, the derived `issue`) -/

/-- In-place extension (DS-v1, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
`extra` available cells follow it. -/
def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length

/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v1). -/
instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
  unfold InPlace; infer_instance

/-- The grown block (DS-v1, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`, same
destination; an issuance of §46). -/
def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, x.dst⟩

/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Stack :=
  { st with
    top := st.top + extra
    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a else y }

/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero (reading recorded); `release` of `b` (O3);
then the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size
`size + extra` into the recorded destination, on the released state: its static checks
(`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state unchanged, unless the extension is in place
(DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split` of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new
block (O8). -/
inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ (.ok s₃) →
      GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length), D.fresh⟩)

reading "any cell at a position at or above the top of `m`", it is rejected. -/

    DReach K0 wst d12 ∧ d12.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ ∧
    st9.internal ∈ d12.kern.ancs 8 ∧ 3 ∈ st9.cells.drop m0.top ∧ 3 ∉ above st9 m0 ∧
    ∃ D', RewindStep K0 0 m0 d12 (.ok D') := by
  have r11 : DReach K0 wst d11 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide))))
  have r12 : DReach K0 wst d12 := .step r11 (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨r12, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    ⟨_, .ok (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))⟩⟩

with no right on the stack value (`¬ AdminRight`) rewinds to the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩`: the
outcome is `fail` (dead mark checked first); with the right of §36 checked first it is `reject`.

for more cells than the storage has: `fail` (availability), although the requested cells are not all

    DReach K0 wst d13 ∧ ¬ AdminRight d13.kern st9 ∧ RewindStep K0 0 m1 d13 .fail ∧
    GrowStep K0 0 5 0 d9 .reject ∧
    ReleaseStep 5 d9.kern (.ok (releaseEff d9.kern 5)) ∧

def s14 : S3 :=
  splitEff (releaseEff d14.kern 5) st5.internal [cellsOf st5 x5.base (x5.size + 1)]

/-- `grow(0, 5, 1)` in `d14`: `release(5)`, `split(4, [[2, 3]])`, `store(6, 4)` into the recorded
destination 4 (DS-v1, Part XIV, §77). -/
def d15 : DState :=
  ⟨storeEff s14 (releaseEff d14.kern 5).A.length x5.dst,
    d14.stacks.set 0 (growMeta st5 x5 1 (releaseEff d14.kern 5).A.length), d14.fresh⟩

/-- **Reading of the `grow` destination: the recorded `Blk.dst`** (DS-v1, non-normative; §63, §65,
§77). In `d14`, the block value of block 5, recorded with destination 4, was transferred to place 5,
which now holds authority 5, and place 4 is `Moved`. `grow(0, 5, 1)` is `ok` and stores the new
block authority 6 into the moved-from place 4, which becomes `Init`. Under the reading "the current
holder of `b`", the static checks of the derived issue and `store` into place 5 are `ok` on the same
released and split state, and authority 6 is held by place 5: another arrival state. -/
theorem reading_grow_dst :
    DReach K0 wst d14 ∧ d14.stacks[0]? = some st5 ∧ st5.block 5 = some x5 ∧ x5.dst = 4 ∧
    d14.kern.A[5]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) ∧ d14.kern.I 4 = .moved ∧
    GrowStep K0 0 5 1 d14 (.ok d15) ∧
    d15.kern.A[d14.kern.A.length]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) ∧ d15.kern.I 4 = .init ∧
    IssueStatic (releaseEff d14.kern 5) st5.entry (cellsOf st5 x5.base (x5.size + 1)) 5 ∧
    StoreStep (releaseEff d14.kern 5).A.length 5 s14
      (.ok (storeEff s14 (releaseEff d14.kern 5).A.length 5)) ∧
    (storeEff s14 (releaseEff d14.kern 5).A.length 5).A[d14.kern.A.length]?.map (·.holder) =
      some (.place 5) := by
  have r1 : DReach K0 wst d1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  have r2 : DReach K0 wst d2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
  have r3 : DReach K0 wst d3 := .step r2 (.newStack (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))
  have r4 : DReach K0 wst d4 := .step r3 (.mark (.ok (st := st3) (by decide)))
  have r5 : DReach K0 wst d5 := .step r4
    (.push (.ok (st := st4) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨.step r5 (.kernel (.transfer (.ok (by decide)))), by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide,
    by decide,
    .ok (st := st5) (x := x5) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)
      (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)),
    by decide, by decide, by decide, .ok (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- Statics of the `newStack` reading (§47; DS-v1 reading of §76.5): leaf 0, `Uninit`, owned by
frame 0, is the stack value; leaf 1, owned by static 0, is the storage, whose root authority 1 is
held by place 0. -/
def wsu : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false), ((none, some 0, 0), false)]

/-- **Reading of the `newStack` preconditions: §76.5 applies** (DS-v1, non-normative; §76.1–§76.3,
§76.5, §56). In the initial state of `wsu`, `newStack(1, 1)` is rejected: the stack value 0 holding
`internal` 1 is `Uninit` (§76.5). Every other precondition holds: storage 1 usable under
exercisable `Modify` (§76.1); `internal` 1 active, of own mode `Modify`, exercisable (§76.2), held
by place 0 with the footprint of the storage (§76.3); the guard of §56. Under the reading that
drops §76.5 for a stack, the outcome is `ok`. -/
theorem reading_newStack :
    DReach K0 wsu (DState.init wsu) ∧ NewStackStep [] 1 1 (DState.init wsu) .reject ∧
    (DState.init wsu).kern.A[1]? = some ⟨.modify, none, [1], .place 0, true⟩ ∧
    (DState.init wsu).kern.I 0 = .uninit ∧ ¬ LeavesInit (DState.init wsu).kern (.place 0) ∧
    (DState.init wsu).kern.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight (DState.init wsu).kern .modify 1 ∧
    (DState.init wsu).kern.ExercisableAt 1 .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (DState.init wsu).kern.afp 1, l ∈ footprint (DState.init wsu).kern.P 1) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (DState.init wsu).kern.P 1, l ∈ (DState.init wsu).kern.afp 1) ∧
    Guard56 [stackInternals (DState.init wsu).kern (DState.init wsu).stacks] 1 :=
  ⟨.init, .reject (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- A callee frame with no parameter and no local, entered after the program's `release(5)` that
follows the rewind (§72; DS-v1, non-normative: reading of the reasons for which `rewind`
rejects). -/
def d16 : DState := ⟨enterEff d11.kern [] [], d11.stacks, d11.fresh⟩

/-- **Reading of the reasons for which `rewind` rejects: §36 applies** (DS-v1, non-normative; §36,
§61.1). In `d16`, mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is live for stack 0 and no active authority derived from
`internal` 4 covers the cell 2 above it (blocks 5, 6 and 7 are released): every condition DS-v1
lists for the `ok` case holds. The callee has no right on the stack value (`¬ AdminRight`, §36), so
`rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is `reject` and never `ok` (`rewind_ok_iff`); `split` of `internal` alone would
reject too (`internal` is not exercisable at `Modify`, §61.1). Under the reading that DS-v1 lists
every reason to reject, the outcome is `ok`. -/
theorem reading_rewind_right :
    DReach K0 wst d16 ∧ d16.stacks[0]? = some st9 ∧ LiveMark 0 st9 m0 ∧
    (∀ (x l : Nat) (y : Authority), d16.kern.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
      st9.internal ∈ d16.kern.ancs x → l ∈ y.footprint → l ∉ above st9 m0) ∧
    ¬ AdminRight d16.kern st9 ∧ ¬ d16.kern.ExercisableAt st9.internal .modify ∧
    RewindStep K0 0 m0 d16 .reject ∧ ¬ ∃ D', RewindStep K0 0 m0 d16 (.ok D') := by
  have r16 : DReach K0 wst d16 :=
    .step (.step d9_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide)))))
      (.kernel (.enter (.ok (by decide))))
  have hst : d16.stacks[0]? = some st9 := by decide
  have hna : ¬ AdminRight d16.kern st9 := by decide
  have hb : ∀ x ∈ List.range d16.kern.A.length, OptP (d16.kern.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      st9.internal ∈ d16.kern.ancs x → ∀ l ∈ above st9 m0, l ∉ y.footprint) True := by decide
  refine ⟨r16, hst, by decide, fun x l y hy ya hx hly hl => ?_, hna, by decide,
    .static hst (by decide) hna, fun h => hna ((rewind_ok_iff r16 hst).1 h).2.1⟩
  have := hb x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
  rw [hy] at this
  exact this ya hx l hl hly

end Witness

end Ern.Lib.DataStack

* Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v2).
* Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v2).
* §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read for a stack (DS-v2).
* Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v2).
* Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v2).
* The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no rights to the kerne
* The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v2).
* Reading a list after `set` (support for the §46 metadata updates of DS-v2).
* Reading a list after appending one element (support for the §46 metadata updates of DS-v2).
* `takeWhile (· ≠ m)` stops at the first occurrence of `m` (support for the §46 metadata of DS-v2 `rewind`).
* A prefix of `take` (support for DS-v2 `grow`, §46 metadata: the old cells are a prefix of the new ones).

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5,
§76.6). §76.6 is read on the resulting state (v0.1 §76.6): its kernel component is `s`, since
`newArena` changes no kernel component (§76 `ok` effect, `newArena_kernel`), so `WF3`, `I1`,
`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are required of the whole kernel state `s`; the new entry is
the one `newArenaEff` registers, `available` holding the leaves of the storage and `issued`
empty, and it must satisfy `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
  /-- §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  wf3 : WF3 s
  /-- §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  i1 : I1 s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrder` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld s
  /-- §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
    ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6 (read on the resulting state, v0.1 §76.6). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

454:For every administrative abstraction, including arenas, `HandlePool`, and `DataStack`, **`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable on the administering value**. The `writeShared` branch alone is insufficient. `MetaRight` governs the creation or recycling of authorities over existing storage; it does not govern the creation of a fresh allocation by `alloc` (Section 71). Concurrency between calls belongs to Spec 2. Operations issuing, recycling, ending, or invalidating regions must preserve active authorities and dependencies. Allocation through administration shared among simultaneous holders, under an interface not providing such exclusive exercise, cannot be expressed in safe code with only these sequential operations: any synchronized implementation of it belongs to Spec 2. These abstractions remain libraries and add no rights to the kernel.
579:The arena is **live** if `internal` is active. The **arena value** is the place holding `internal`, distinct from the possible owner of `storage`. Administered storage may be local, static, allocated, or issued by another arena, under `newArena` preconditions and applicable invariants. `available` and `issued` remain **in the library's arena entry**.
917:An arena is a **library abstraction**, not a memory-kernel primitive. Operations O17 through O19 are **derived** from operations O1 through O16 and abstraction-specific metadata: `newArena` registers an administration without modifying the kernel; `issue` performs `split` followed by `store` (after checking availability); `reset` performs a `Modify` derivation over all storage—through `derive` or `split`—then `release`, before restoring availability. Their contract below is **normative for the standard-library arena** until Spec 10 takes responsibility for it. It authorizes neither new permissions nor an additional access machine. Arena entries (Section 46) constitute the abstract state of this administration; the guard in Section 56 belongs to its consistency contract. The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and are not defined here.
938:1. The `arena` entry exists and is live; `internal` is active. `MetaRight` requires exercisable `Modify` over the arena value holding `internal` (Section 36). Mutation of metadata through `writeShared` alone does not satisfy this condition.
